text: Running an MR brand in 2026 is one of the best E-com business models right now to go ahead and do. And the reason why I say this is because you're not going to be dependent on Facebook. Most of you guys, if you end up losing your ad account today, you guys are going to go straight back to zero with your revenue. No new net revenue coming in. And if your ad account is not live, you're not generating any money. And the reason why MR so monthly recurring revenues, the best business model right now is because you have recurring revenue coming in every single 30 days, 60 days, or even 90 days. So you got customers receiving a product every single month from your store without you having to pay a single dollar on ads in order to get them back to your store. And that is what makes this business model so great because you do not need to be dependent on Facebook ads. And you can go ahead and even outskill your competitors because you can see how much forecasting you have for the next month. And then you can dedicate that into pushing into ads and generating more revenue and thus scaling into six, seven, eight figures per month.
